LLM Usage Policy for European Energy Price Analyzer
Version: 1.0
Last-Updated: 2026-05-04

Contact: https://topsrek.top
Repository: https://github.com/topsrek/austrian-electricity-price-analysis

Scope: This file communicates our preferences to AI/LLM crawlers. It is advisory and does not replace robots.txt.

Allowed Purposes:
- Indexing for search and discovery
- Summarization, snippet generation, and question answering with citation

Disallowed Purposes:
- Training foundation models on our content without explicit permission
- Storing or redistributing full content or datasets derived from it
- Reproducing large excerpts (> 200 characters) without attribution and link

Crawler Guidance:
- Respect robots.txt and meta robots directives
- Include a source link to the original page when using our content
- Avoid collecting personal data; remove sensitive information

Named Agents Policy:
- GPTBot: Allowed for browsing and summarization
- OAI-SearchBot: Allowed
- Google-Extended: Allowed
- CCBot (Common Crawl): Allowed for indexing only
- ClaudeBot / Claude-Web: Allowed
- PerplexityBot: Allowed
- Applebot / Applebot-Extended: Allowed
- Meta-ExternalAgent: Allowed

Rate Limiting:
- Please keep request rates reasonable (<= 1 request/second) and use caching

If you need an exception or commercial license, please reach out via the contact above.
